review_notes: Independently read the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, both disposition ledgers, both owned files in canonical and rendered form, and all baseline subject and link pages. This verdict applies to the current top-level proposal, not the different proposal embedded in the librarian packet.

All eight proposed writes address owned subjects, use allowed fact types, and have canonical evidence. The required empty collections remain empty. In particular, the current proposal repairs the item purpose's once-only and instance-only wording rather than merely retaining it with an implicit qualification.

Verified counter transitions at old states 0, 1 and 65535; history-only reset; exact two-field duplicate suppression; index-9 wrap versus arbitrary-index normalization; zero-valued identities; and s32 comparison followed by u16 storage. Safe insertion still requires valid objects, user data, table and current_index.

Independently verified ftLib_80086960 against its canonical implementation. It checks non-NULL ownership and the fighter classifier. The rendered ftLib_IsFighter alias is not independent evidence of an authored name.

Verified actual fighter and item instance setters and fighter refresh path, the player table accessor, damage-processing callers, and the weighted consumer. Ten entries participate in duplicate suppression, but at most nine newest entries participate in the examined weighted scan. The consumer stops at move ID zero and scaling has a debug-level bypass.

No callback registration, deferred retention, ownership transfer, allocation, floating-point operation or optional implementation branch occurs in the owned C file. The header has an include guard. External floating-point behavior and lifecycle scheduling are not elevated to local guarantees.

The existing increment state_behavior fact is compatible with its proposed more explicit replacement; its retain disposition below judges the baseline claim supportable rather than forbidding the proposed refinement.

Acceptance preserves explicit deferrals: section and compiled-layout claims are not proved by source declarations, and projectile-per-animation identity sharing is not proved by a resident-pair scan. General gameplay relationships do not establish universal numerical damage reduction for arbitrary weights or exceptional floats.

renderer_issues: No parse errors; one function-name substitution, ftLib_80086960 to ftLib_IsFighter. Canonical predicate independently verified; alias not treated as authored-name proof.
